chunks.heading: Accepted payment methods
sentences: Workspaces can pay by credit or debit card on any paid plan.
Yearly plans with a total of 2,000 USD or more can also pay by bank transfer against an invoice, with payment due within 30 days.
Prices are charged in USD, EUR or GBP; the currency is chosen when the first paid plan starts and can only be changed by support.
chunks.text: Workspaces can pay by credit or debit card on any paid plan. Yearly plans with a total of 2,000 USD or more can also pay by bank transfer against an invoice, with payment due within 30 days. Prices are charged in USD, EUR or GBP; the currency is chosen when the first paid plan starts and can only be changed by support.

chunks.heading: Billing invoices
sentences: Pellbrook sends a billing invoice to the billing email address after every payment.
Owners can download all past billing invoices as PDF files from Settings, then Billing, then Invoice history.
These are invoices for your subscription, not the invoices you send to your own clients.
chunks.text: Pellbrook sends a billing invoice to the billing email address after every payment. Owners can download all past billing invoices as PDF files from Settings, then Billing, then Invoice history. These are invoices for your subscription, not the invoices you send to your own clients.

chunks.heading: Sales tax and VAT
sentences: Customers in the European Union are charged VAT at their country's rate unless they enter a valid VAT ID in the billing settings.
Customers in the United Kingdom are charged UK VAT.
A VAT ID added later applies from the next invoice; past invoices are not reissued.
chunks.text: Customers in the European Union are charged VAT at their country's rate unless they enter a valid VAT ID in the billing settings. Customers in the United Kingdom are charged UK VAT. A VAT ID added later applies from the next invoice; past invoices are not reissued.

chunks.heading: Changing the billing email
sentences: Only the workspace owner can change the billing email address and the payment card.
chunks.text: Only the workspace owner can change the billing email address and the payment card.

chunks.heading: Upgrading
sentences: An upgrade starts at once.
You pay the price difference for the rest of the current billing period, prorated by day.
New features are available as soon as the payment goes through.
chunks.text: An upgrade starts at once. You pay the price difference for the rest of the current billing period, prorated by day. New features are available as soon as the payment goes through.

chunks.heading: Downgrading
sentences: A downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period, monthly or yearly.
Until then you keep the features of your current plan.
Before the downgrade, check that the lower plan supports your number of users and projects; extra projects are archived, not deleted.
chunks.text: A downgrade takes effect at the end of the current billing period, monthly or yearly. Until then you keep the features of your current plan. Before the downgrade, check that the lower plan supports your number of users and projects; extra projects are archived, not deleted.

chunks.heading: Cancelling a subscription
sentences: Cancelling stops the next renewal.
The workspace keeps its paid plan until the end of the period that was already paid for, and then moves to the Free plan.
Cancelling a subscription does not delete your data.
To delete the workspace and all its data, see Closing your account.
chunks.text: Cancelling stops the next renewal. The workspace keeps its paid plan until the end of the period that was already paid for, and then moves to the Free plan. Cancelling a subscription does not delete your data. To delete the workspace and all its data, see Closing your account.

chunks.docTitle: Adding and removing users on a paid plan
chunks.heading: Adding users
sentences: When you invite a new user to a paid workspace, you pay for the rest of the current billing period straight away.
The charge is prorated by day.
For example, adding one Team user halfway through a monthly period costs about half of one month's price.
chunks.text: When you invite a new user to a paid workspace, you pay for the rest of the current billing period straight away. The charge is prorated by day. For example, adding one Team user halfway through a monthly period costs about half of one month's price.

chunks.docTitle: Adding and removing users on a paid plan
chunks.heading: Removing users on monthly billing
sentences: When you remove a user on a monthly plan, the unused days become a credit.
The credit is applied to your next invoice automatically.
Credits are not paid out as cash.
chunks.text: When you remove a user on a monthly plan, the unused days become a credit. The credit is applied to your next invoice automatically. Credits are not paid out as cash.

chunks.docTitle: Adding and removing users on a paid plan
chunks.heading: Removing users on yearly billing
sentences: On yearly billing, removing a user frees the seat for someone else, but the number of paid seats only goes down at the next renewal.
To lower the seat count at renewal, change the seat number in Settings, then Billing before the renewal date.
chunks.text: On yearly billing, removing a user frees the seat for someone else, but the number of paid seats only goes down at the next renewal. To lower the seat count at renewal, change the seat number in Settings, then Billing before the renewal date.

chunks.docTitle: Adding and removing users on a paid plan
chunks.heading: Deactivated users
sentences: Deactivated users are not counted as paid users.
Their past time entries stay in reports and invoices.
chunks.text: Deactivated users are not counted as paid users. Their past time entries stay in reports and invoices.

chunks.heading: Common error codes
sentences: Status 401 means the token is missing, wrong or revoked.
Status 403 means the token is valid but the user may not do this action, for example a member trying to edit another member's entries, or a write call on the Starter plan.
Status 404 means the item does not exist or the user cannot see it.
Status 422 means a field is missing or has a wrong value; the response lists the fields.
chunks.text: Status 401 means the token is missing, wrong or revoked. Status 403 means the token is valid but the user may not do this action, for example a member trying to edit another member's entries, or a write call on the Starter plan. Status 404 means the item does not exist or the user cannot see it. Status 422 means a field is missing or has a wrong value; the response lists the fields.

chunks.heading: Revoked tokens
sentences: A token stops working when the user revokes it, when the user is deactivated or when the user changes their password.
Create a new token after a password change.
chunks.text: A token stops working when the user revokes it, when the user is deactivated or when the user changes their password. Create a new token after a password change.

chunks.heading: Time formats
sentences: All times in the API are in UTC and use the ISO 8601 format.
Durations are given in seconds.
chunks.text: All times in the API are in UTC and use the ISO 8601 format. Durations are given in seconds.

chunks.heading: Access and tokens
sentences: The Pellbrook Hours API is a REST API that returns JSON.
Each user creates a personal API token in Profile, then API tokens.
A token has the same permissions as the user who created it.
Starter plans have read-only access; Team and Business plans can read and write.
chunks.text: The Pellbrook Hours API is a REST API that returns JSON. Each user creates a personal API token in Profile, then API tokens. A token has the same permissions as the user who created it. Starter plans have read-only access; Team and Business plans can read and write.

chunks.heading: Rate limits
sentences: Requests are limited per workspace: 60 requests per minute on Starter, 120 per minute on Team and 600 per minute on Business.
When you go over the limit, the API answers with status 429 and a Retry-After header that says how many seconds to wait.
chunks.text: Requests are limited per workspace: 60 requests per minute on Starter, 120 per minute on Team and 600 per minute on Business. When you go over the limit, the API answers with status 429 and a Retry-After header that says how many seconds to wait.

chunks.heading: Pagination
sentences: List endpoints return up to 100 items per page.
Use the cursor value from the response to ask for the next page.
Results are sorted by the time they were last changed.
chunks.text: List endpoints return up to 100 items per page. Use the cursor value from the response to ask for the next page. Results are sorted by the time they were last changed.

chunks.docTitle: Client did not receive an invoice email
chunks.heading: Check the address and the spam folder
sentences: Open the invoice and check the client's email address.
Ask the client to look in their spam or junk folder.
Invoice emails are sent from invoices@pellbrook.example with your company name as the sender name.
chunks.text: Open the invoice and check the client's email address. Ask the client to look in their spam or junk folder. Invoice emails are sent from invoices@pellbrook.example with your company name as the sender name.

chunks.docTitle: Client did not receive an invoice email
chunks.heading: Bounced addresses
sentences: If an email address bounced before, we stop sending to it.
The invoice then shows the status Not delivered.
Correct the address on the client record and send the invoice again.
chunks.text: If an email address bounced before, we stop sending to it. The invoice then shows the status Not delivered. Correct the address on the client record and send the invoice again.

chunks.docTitle: Client did not receive an invoice email
chunks.heading: Sending the PDF yourself
sentences: You can always download the invoice as a PDF and send it from your own email.
chunks.text: You can always download the invoice as a PDF and send it from your own email.

chunks.heading: Rounding
sentences: If a project uses rounding, report totals use rounded time, while the timesheet shows exact time.
Each entry is rounded on its own, so totals can differ by several minutes.
Switch rounding off in the report options to compare exact times.
chunks.text: If a project uses rounding, report totals use rounded time, while the timesheet shows exact time. Each entry is rounded on its own, so totals can differ by several minutes. Switch rounding off in the report options to compare exact times.

chunks.heading: Time zones
sentences: Reports use the time zone of the person viewing them.
An entry made late at night can fall on a different day for a colleague in another time zone, which changes daily and weekly totals.

chunks.heading: Filters
sentences: Check the approval and billable filters.
A report filtered to approved time leaves out timesheets that are still waiting for approval.
chunks.text: Check the approval and billable filters. A report filtered to approved time leaves out timesheets that are still waiting for approval.

chunks.heading: Forgotten password
sentences: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email address.
The reset link is valid for one hour and can be used once.
If the email does not arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder.
chunks.text: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page and enter your email address. The reset link is valid for one hour and can be used once. If the email does not arrive within a few minutes, check your spam folder.

chunks.heading: Lost the phone with your two-step codes
sentences: Use one of the 10 recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in.
Each code works once.
If you have no recovery codes left, ask a workspace admin to reset two-step sign-in for your account; owners must contact support and prove their identity.
chunks.text: Use one of the 10 recovery codes you saved when you turned on two-step sign-in. Each code works once. If you have no recovery codes left, ask a workspace admin to reset two-step sign-in for your account; owners must contact support and prove their identity.

chunks.heading: Single sign-on users
sentences: If your workspace requires single sign-on, the password form does not work for you.
Choose Sign in with SSO and enter your work email address.
chunks.text: If your workspace requires single sign-on, the password form does not work for you. Choose Sign in with SSO and enter your work email address.

chunks.heading: Too many attempts
sentences: After 10 failed sign-in attempts in 15 minutes, sign-in for that account is paused for 15 minutes.
chunks.text: After 10 failed sign-in attempts in 15 minutes, sign-in for that account is paused for 15 minutes.

chunks.heading: Check the offline banner
sentences: If the orange offline banner is showing, the phone has no connection to Pellbrook Hours.
Entries are kept on the phone for up to 7 days and will sync when the connection is back.
Pull down on the Timesheet screen to try again.
chunks.text: If the orange offline banner is showing, the phone has no connection to Pellbrook Hours. Entries are kept on the phone for up to 7 days and will sync when the connection is back. Pull down on the Timesheet screen to try again.

chunks.heading: Turn off battery optimisation
sentences: Some Android phones stop apps from working in the background to save battery.
Open the Android Settings, then Apps, then Pellbrook Hours, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted.
Without this, entries may only sync while the app is open.
chunks.text: Some Android phones stop apps from working in the background to save battery. Open the Android Settings, then Apps, then Pellbrook Hours, then Battery, and choose Unrestricted. Without this, entries may only sync while the app is open.

chunks.heading: Do not clear the app storage
sentences: Clearing the app storage or signing out deletes entries that have not synced yet.
Let the waiting entries sync first.

chunks.heading: Allow background refresh
sentences: On iPhone, entries only sync in the background if Background App Refresh is on for Pellbrook Hours.
Open the iPhone Settings, then General, then Background App Refresh, and switch it on for the app.
Low Power Mode also pauses background refresh.

chunks.heading: Do not sign out with waiting entries
sentences: Signing out of the app deletes entries that have not synced yet.

chunks.heading: The timer stopped by itself
sentences: A timer stops automatically after 24 hours.
It also stops when you start another timer on any device, because each user can run only one timer at a time.
chunks.text: A timer stops automatically after 24 hours. It also stops when you start another timer on any device, because each user can run only one timer at a time.

chunks.heading: The timer shows on one device but not another
sentences: The running timer is shared across the web, desktop and mobile apps.
If a device shows an old state, refresh the web page or pull down on the mobile Timesheet screen.
A phone that is offline shows the timer it knew about when it lost the connection.

chunks.heading: Idle time was not detected
sentences: Idle detection works only in the desktop app.
On macOS, the app needs the Accessibility permission in System Settings, then Privacy and Security, to notice keyboard and mouse activity.
chunks.text: Idle detection works only in the desktop app. On macOS, the app needs the Accessibility permission in System Settings, then Privacy and Security, to notice keyboard and mouse activity.

chunks.heading: How approvals work
sentences: On the Team and Business plans, admins can turn on approvals in Settings, then Approvals.
Members then submit their timesheet once a week.
Their manager reviews it and approves it or sends it back with a comment.
chunks.text: On the Team and Business plans, admins can turn on approvals in Settings, then Approvals. Members then submit their timesheet once a week. Their manager reviews it and approves it or sends it back with a comment.

chunks.heading: Who approves
sentences: Each member has one approver, which is their manager by default.
Admins can choose a different approver for any member.
If the approver is away, any admin can approve the timesheet.
chunks.text: Each member has one approver, which is their manager by default. Admins can choose a different approver for any member. If the approver is away, any admin can approve the timesheet.

chunks.heading: Locked timesheets
sentences: An approved timesheet is locked, and its entries cannot be changed or deleted.
To change a locked entry, an admin reopens the timesheet, which sends it back to the member.
Admins can also lock all timesheets older than a set number of days, even if they were not approved, with the Auto-lock setting.

chunks.heading: Setting a budget
sentences: On the Team and Business plans, each project can have a budget in hours or in money.
Open the project, then Budget, and enter the amount.
A budget can be a total for the whole project or reset every month.

chunks.heading: Budget alerts

Since version 5.3 you can add your own alert levels, for example 50% or 90%.
Members do not get budget emails unless a manager adds them to the alert list.
